facts.fact: Bank Al-Maghrib oversees Morocco's payment systems, including the SIMT retail clearing system, under article 10 of law 76-03 and a multilateral oversight convention signed by all infrastructure managers.
A proposed reform of the rules on payment systems and means of payment would broaden the Bank's prerogatives and require its prior approval of any payment, clearing or settlement system.
